name: File Type Validator
description: Check whether a file is genuinely a supported document before parsing it, by content rather than by extension.
install: Optional content detection: pip install python-magic (needs the libmagic system library). Without it the component runs on its own signature table. Copy with: ragkit add file-type-validator
missing_dependency_message: file-type-validator needs no package by default. python-magic is optional and only requested when you construct FileTypeValidator(use_magic=True); install it with pip install python-magic, and note libmagic is a system library rather than a wheel.
